# TasteGraph

> Local-first personal TasteGraph: a living multi-dimensional preference graph for aesthetic, creative, design, and cultural taste.

- Site: https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/
- Interactive wheel: https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/wheel/
- Updates log: https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/updates/
- Updates JSON: https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/updates/log.json
- Source: https://github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/TasteGraph-Skill
- License: MIT
- Public graph / wheel version: 1.3.15

## One-liner
Structured loves, hard antis, aesthetic registers, motion stack, exportable system prompts, and a 3D decision-weight wheel - files on your disk, not a cloud profile.

## Quick answers
- What is it? An open-source agent skill + JSON schema for personal taste graphs, plus an interactive wheel on the product site.
- Where is the wheel? https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/wheel/
- Where is the changelog? https://tastegraph.jonbailey.xyz/updates/ (JSON twin: /updates/log.json)
- Who is it for? Designers, artists, builders, and agents that generate visual work.
- Does it store PII? No. Schema and skill forbid PII; sample graphs are synthetic. Public wheel may credit public posts with source links.

## Standing product practices
- Public pie examples from art/design posts include source links (credit + href) when the post URL is known.
- Every material public wheel or site ship appends an entry to /updates/ and /updates/log.json (newest first).
